GlobalProtect 6.2.1 Known Issues

The following table lists the known issues in GlobalProtect 6.2.1.

Windows Known Issues

Issue ID Description
GPC-12345 GlobalProtect app may fail to connect when using SAML authentication with certain identity providers.
GPC-12346 The split tunnel configuration is not applied correctly when multiple subnets are specified.
GPC-12347 Users may experience connection drops when switching between WiFi networks.

Issue ID Description
